reviews.text: Today we lost my beautiful   luna  16 year old  german shepherd   thank you Jack   for your kindness

Amazing was very reassuring to my cat we’ve drawn up a plan for now to help manage her comfort Jack & his wife both speak with empathy and understanding the fact he does come to see my cat in her home helps massively highly recommended

Absolutely brilliant. No hassle, what a genuine lovely person Jack is. We are so pleased we were able to have him call on us to give Buster our adoptive ten year old cat his vaccination and nail trim. We are all very happy and I feel certain Buster feels better now his claws do not catch on to everything. Thank you Jack. A truly genuine animal lover.

We found Garvey Vets when we were looking for support for our much loved dachshund, Freddo, who was very poorly. From our very first enquiry, the care and compassion we received was incredible.

We initially spoke to Liz, who was absolutely amazing. She answered all of our questions, put us completely at ease and kept in touch with us throughout. Freddo was never a fan of going to the vets, so when the time came, it was really important to us that he could pass peacefully and comfortably in his own home. Liz made us feel completely supported in making that happen.

From the moment we met Jack, we knew Freddo was in the very best hands. He was incredibly kind, calm and compassionate, talked us gently through the whole process and took such wonderful care of Freddo and of us both during an incredibly difficult time.

The communication, support and genuine care we received from both Liz and Jack meant more to us than we can put into words. At one of the hardest times, they made everything feel peaceful, dignified and full of kindness.

We feel incredibly lucky that we found Garvey Vets and simply cannot recommend them both highly enough. What an amazing business and two truly wonderful people. Thank you for taking care of our boy 💙

Would highly recommend Garvey Vets. Jack was fantastic with mom's elderly dog from start to finish, explained everything in detail as we proceeded and gave our girl the most peaceful and dignified end to her wonderful life. Thank you so much Jack and Liz- we are so grateful 🐾 xx

We came to Jack and Liz (Garveys Vets) when the time had come to let our precious boy go.  I can’t speak highly enough of what they have done for us.  Jack was so sensitive and understanding when he came out and made the process as good as it could be for me and my family.  The support we have had since has been nothing short of exceptional and this has made the grieving process easier for us all.  Thank you both so much, you are a credit to yourselves and to the profession you are in. Will & Emma
Jack just came out to have a look at our Black cat for us, as he had a problem with his back leg.  Great service.  Jack put us at ease.    So glad we called his Vet service now.

Jack and Liz are absolutely amazing! Jack, the vet was very reassuring I felt like I had known him forever. Their prices are so affordable compared to other vet practices which rip you off! They go above and beyond to help, offer advice and all the animals get fuss! Thank you guys! Keep up the work!

Lovely vet very knowledgeable and wants to work with the customer to get the best results for their pets  and explores all alternative options that are available in treatment rather than just giving  1 fits all solution . Very happy to have found Jack to look after my pets.

Wow what a service, been a long time since I've met a Vet like Jack Garvey and his wife Liz.(Actually cared for the patient not just the £'s)
Called Garvey vets as my Mastiff Bolo could not stand and was seriously ill, as our practice vet refused a home visit and could not recommend a mobile vet.
Googled mobile vets in Sutton Coldfield.... Jack Garvey vet came up, got the last visit (appointment to home) Brilliant spot on diagnosis and immediate action taken by Jack Garvey, bit of a shock really as my wife and I thought it was that time we all dread for our 11 year old Mastiff Bolo who is normally bullet proof. Jack even wrote out a private prescription as Bolo is a Large Breed and the meds prescribed are expensive, he even ran us through the ordering procedure for the online pharmacy as he could see we were just as distressed as The Bolo.
Turned out the online pharmacy had a delay in there system and basically messed up on delivery!
Call to Garvey vets for help?
This is where Liz stepped in, "No problem I'll call Jack"( who was on another call out) Liz called us back ASAP to say she would personally deliver enough meds to get us through till our delayed online order arrived. Jack also called us to see how The Bolo was doing and asked us if he could help find us a Cardiologist as The Bolo was responding so well, we agreed and Bolo is back to his normal lively/ cheeky/demanding 11 year old self (especially with the Wife 🤭😂🤣)
Thank you Garvey Mobile vets Jack and Liz you provided us with an Outstanding Caring Service. 👍🫡

Having Jack the vet, come to visit our very nervous cat at home is truly a wonderful service. His service is first class and after owning many pets over the years and trips to the vet’s, Jack offers the same expertise in a familiar setting causing the least amount of stress as possible. Excellent price considering Jack’s travel time for appointment. Would 100% recommend to any pet owner, nervous or not to book a home visit if needed.
Jack was brilliant. So caring and understanding. Our Millie is back to normal thanks to Jack. Fully recommend them.

Jack had been out twice to see Rookie,  my Mom’s little dog. Jacks treatment and care for Rookie has been excellent and he has gone over and above each time.
A lovely Young-man and a Fabulous Vet! Attentive to both Rookie and Mom, caring and professional with a warm sensitive nature that put them both at ease.
If you only do one thing right for your pet, then choose Garvey Vets🐶🐱🐰

Very happy that we found Jack. Our dog hated going to the vets so being able to see a vet at home is so nice. We had to make the sad decision to say goodbye to our boy, but Jack spent a lot of time with us and made his passing very stress free and just as Duke would want it, in his own bed surrounded by the people he loved the most. They sent lovely condolence cards with his paw prints and returned his ashes to us. Thank you so much.

My local vet recommended Garvey Vets for a very poorly stray male cat called Tom-tom who had never been to the vets, handled or stroked. Jack came out same day and managed a difficult situation with insight, expertise, care and compassion. Jack explained his illness in detail and after i had weighed up the options it was time to say goodbye to a cat i had fed for years and until 3 weeks ago had never wanted to come indoors. Jack also arranged his cremation. Tom-tom is now at peace and so am i knowing that he is not suffering anymore. Thankyou Jack for the wonderful unique service you provide for us and all fur babies.

I have nothing but the highest praise for Jack and Liz. Jack has helped my boys so much enjoy their later years pain free. When Jack came to put Henry to sleep last week he was so kind and understanding. The cards and paw print from our boy off Jack after was so lovely. There’s only vets we’d use….

I can’t recommend Jack enough, he is such a kind and compassionate vet. You helped make our poorly dog comfortable in November and made the experience of euthanasia the best it could be. Forever grateful! Everyone needs to saves Jacks number!

Garvey Vets were very friendly, professional, and supportive with the treatment of my pet. They went above and beyond by not only providing the initial care requested, but also provided recommendations for care of my pet to reduce the risk of further callouts, underlining the importance of welfare of the animal.

10/10, I would recommend this vet to all my friends and family.

Zhukov (my hamster) is proud to have met the Garvey Vets team.

I can’t speak highly enough about the team at Garvey vets. Nothing but professional, thorough and most importantly compassionate service from them; I would  recommend them to anyone. It is easy to see that they genuinely care for the animals they treat.

Thank you Jack and Liz. I appreciate the help you have provided to our family.

After finding your flyer in my local garage to our first phone call ,we knew we had made the correct decision to use you to look after our elderly cat who hated vets. Jack visited on the same day as our call and with care, compassion and professionalism helped us through a difficult time. I can highly recommend and would use you again .

Phoned garvey vets today and spoke to really nice lady on the phone regarding our 2 dogs who were suffering stomach type problems although busy she managed to book us in to see the vet jack who I must say is a really nice guy told us all about what the problems most likely were with jess and Lucy our 2 dogs  and gave us the appropriate medication to help made us feel really comfortable and I honestly can't say enough good words about Jack and the service he provides his wife even phoned us to say he was going to be a little bit late fantastic service I must say .we will now be using Jack as our vet from now on his professionalism is the best I've come in years of owning dogs and using local vets thank you Jack keep up your great work you are a credit to your job..

The appointment was wonderful! Jack was friendly, patient, and extremely knowledgeable. For the first time, my Rocky felt relaxed, which I really appreciated. The explanations were clear and helpful, and the service was exceptional. I highly recommend!

Thank you so much Jack and Liz
When the time came for us to say Goodbye to our beautiful boy Archie I can’t thank you enough for the care and understanding for us as a family and for Archie I recommend you to everyone I know Brillant service and lovely people
Sarah and family

Fantastic vet service. Jack is wonderful and understands what needs to be done. So glad we found out about this mobile service. Liz is so helpful over the phone. Could not have wished for a better service  thank you Claire and sparkle ✨️

Garvey Vets were the perfect solution to help with my 2 golden retrievers; 1 dislikes going to the vets, 1 is dog reactive so vet waiting rooms are really hard for us both.
Jack was fab, coming 4 weeks on the trot to give them both their pain relief injections. No stress for the dogs. No stress for me. Cooper loved greeting Jack at the front door with his fluffy goose in his mouth! Such a positive experience for both dogs.
Thank you Jack!

Highly  recommend this vet service.
Great prices, very professional and friendly

I came upon Jack Garvey whilst walking Meg our 13 year old Black Labrador where I met his father out walking their 3 dogs and I was telling him about the very poor service that we had received from two of our local vets and he suggested I contact Jack who he was sure could help.
Well Jack came to see Meg and diagnosed Meg's serious condition straight away (not like the local vets) and he has been able to give her several months of calm and pain-free life.
Unfortunately, a few days ago she went off her legs and we suspected the end was near and Jack came out within 2 hours and confirmed our suspicions but he dealt with her in the most professional and caring manner for which we are so grateful.
If you need a vet give Jack a ring because we know that you will not find a more professional and caring vet.

I contacted Garvey Vets when my very nervous cat had end stage kidney failure & it was time to say goodbye. I didn't want to take her to her usual vet practice as it would've been too stressful for us both. I rang in the morning after making the difficult decision & they were really flexible & able to come out the same day. Jack was very kind & patient & explained the whole process beforehand, including after care arrangements. Gladys went to sleep peacefully in my arms, in her own home where she felt safe & Jack gave me all the time I needed to say goodbye. I highly recommend him if you have nervous pets or if you have to say goodbye to them.

I phoned this morning for an appointment and managed to get one for late afternoon for our staffy (she has always been very nervous with vets)
jack came and he was amazing! out girl was so comfortable around him, he was very informative and honest. and diagnosed her after being here for a few minutes.
thank you so much, hopefully we won't need to see you anytime soon (I mean that in a nice way)
but if we ever need a vet, I will be ringing Garvey vets! they really are amazing and very very reasonably priced.
thank you so much!

Jack was professional, knowledgeable and gentle with my skittish cat, Millie. The side of her face was swollen, phoned GarveyVets at 8:30am and asked for whatever appointment was available and thankfully he could squeeze me in same day! He prescribed her some medicine and she was back to normal in a few days. Really well priced too - I was happy. Thank you!!

Jack came out to vaccinate our litter of Labrador puppies, he was excellent at his job, so knowledgeable and helpful with our elderly dog and poorly cat too. Such a fabulous service, would always use Garvey’s in future. Thank you Jack
Brilliant service from Jack. Will highly recommend.

Thank you Dr Jack Garvey for your patience and kindness to our lovely anxious cat Maya.
100% recommended
Thank you so much for the review!

Jack came out today to our 20 year old cat Scoubie, her fur was badly matted, due to her age and arthritic pain she does not groom herself very well.  Jack shaved her fur where needed and gave us good advice on her arthritis. She is now matt free 😁 Scoubie said his bedside manner was excellent 🤣🤣
I would most definately recommend Garvey Vets.

I can’t thank Jack @ Garvey Vets for helping me say goodbye to my 13 year old Cookie. In a horrible situation he was kind, calm and informative. Helping me make the difficult decisions as my Dog was suffered a huge seizure due to a brain tumour.
I can’t recommend Jack enough.
Brian, Kerry & Cookie.

Jack is just amazing! Our Goldie gets very stressed going to the vets so to have Jack visit us meant the world. Jack then spent time assessing her and provided me with amazing advice on care and prevention for her various conditions. Jack is incredibly knowledgeable and could read our dog so well. I may have to call him Dr Doolittle. And most importantly, this evening our girl is pain free and stress free. Thank you. I shall be telling all of my friends about how brilliant you are.

Jack is the loveliest man. Very kind & caring & being mobile was able to come to my house to put my beautiful doggie at peace. I would thoroughly recommend him. His prices are very reasonable & he’s able to offer many services. I’m now using him for my other dog.
So kind and compassionate when it was sadly time to say goodbye bye to my beloved Labrador. The consideration shown to both my dog and family was second to none.
Amazing vet!!! Had Jack round to vaccine our troop of 4 dogs and a cat. No problems at all, happy animals and a stress free and very friendly service. Would highly recommend, not going anywhere else
